title: Dougal and the Blue Cat
writer: Serge Danot, Jean-François Josselin, Eric Thompson
actors: Christian Riehl, Paul Bisciglia, Nadine Legrand
plot: Life at the Magic Roundabout is disrupted when a blue cat called Buxton finds his way into town. Everyone loves Buxton except for Dougal, who discovers the cat's mad plan to become the king of blue army and destroy all who are not...
